name: – After § 5 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text: 5b. Calls on the Council and the Member States to immediately suspend any strategic partnership agreements, including arms transfer agreements, with the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and other third countries found to be fuelling the conflict, for as long as attacks against civilians and violations of international humanitarian law continue;
